title: ow-workbench Workflow
description: Canonical Phase-0 workflow specification for the ow-workbench benchmark.

initial_state.description: The versioned, inspectable starting condition for the workflow.

objective.description: The outcome the participant is asked to achieve.

inputs.description: Information and artifacts available to the participant.

capabilities_tools.description: Capabilities, tools, interfaces, limits, and side effects available during execution.

environment.description: Software, services, data, permissions, network, clock, version, and resource conditions.

constraints.description: Time, budget, safety, privacy, licensing, authority, and operational limits.

hidden_fixtures.description: Versioned deterministic fixtures and controlled failure injections, including protected holdouts.

authority_boundary.description: Actions the participant may take and actions requiring a named human or other authority.

acceptance_contract.description: Observable conditions for deliverables, state transitions, evidence, and safe terminal behavior.

independent_evaluation.description: Versioned checks applied independently to executed state and artifacts.

required_evidence.description: The manifest, trace, artifacts, evaluator evidence, hashes, and configuration provenance required for audit.

terminal_outcome.description: Provisional terminal outcome enum pending open decision 1.
